# Humae | Product Overview

Humae is an AI HR platform for small-scale growth teams, with one staff catalogue, holiday, recruitment, OKR and performance intelligence. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
